entries.en:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in famous battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
The more victories you can achieve, the better the reward at the end!
entries.zh:
选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中的著名战役中面对其他玩家！
通过在提供的张牌群体中选择，以选秀的方式走向胜利，创建你的活动卡组。
你能取得的胜利越多，最后的奖励就越好！

entries.en: During the War of Beasts Marneus Calgar openly challenged the Warmaster. Urged to humiliate the Chapter Master, Abaddon and his elite teleported before Calgar and his retinue on Saint's Haven, where battle immediately broke.
entries.zh: 在兽之战期间，马涅乌思·卡尔加公开挑战了战帅。阿巴顿和他的精英应邀羞辱战团长，他们在圣港前方传送到卡尔加和他的随从面前，战斗立即爆发。

entries.en:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in grand battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
Explore the drafting menu during the demo and see how many victories you can achieve!
entries.zh:
选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中与其他玩家进行宏大的战斗！
通过在提供的卡组群体中选择，制定你的赛事卡组，以此来赢得胜利。
在演示过程中探索选秀菜单，看看你能获得多少胜利！

entries.en: In a Galaxy ripe for conquest, the many warring factions fight to claim it for their own. There is no respite, there is no haven, there is only the law of blade and bullet. Will you be able to lead your faction towards the path of eternity?
entries.zh: 在一个熟透的征服星系中，许多交战的派系为了自己而争夺它。没有休息，没有避难所，只有刀剑和子弹的法则。你能否引导你的派系走向永恒之道？

entries.en: This is your final opportunity to claim the event's special rewards. During the grace period, you can spend any remaining event resources, but you won't be able to earn more through battles or missions.

Earn Medals in Multiplayer mode and completing the daily Raid Mission, and use these to start collecting the new content.
Time is running. Join now, for the Warmaster!
